description: We are NEOREX, a team of enthusiastic B.Tech AI students passionate about Artificial Intelligence, technology, innovation, and problem-solving. We are interested in building creative, real-world solutions through hackathons. We welcome passionate teammates with skills in Python, AI/ML, web development, UI/UX design, frontend, backend, and presentation. We value teamwork, creativity, learning, and collaboration.
summary:
NEOREX ASTRA is an interactive space exploration and learning experience designed to help students understand what it takes to survive and build a base beyond Earth. Instead of learning everything through textbooks, students can explore a 3D lunar outpost, manage resources, and experience the challenges of a space mission.

Our project starts with a Moon mission, where players must manage essential resources such as oxygen, water, food, and electricity while protecting their crew from radiation and other environmental challenges. A Mars campaign is also planned as the next stage of exploration.

We have designed the experience for students aged 7–16, with different learning levels to make science easier to understand for everyone. Students can explore the environment, experiment with space systems, and receive guidance from Dr. Astra, our astronaut mentor.

Our goal is to make space science more engaging, practical, and accessible while inspiring the next generation to think like real space explorers.
details:
NEOREX ASTRA is an interactive space mission learning platform that gives students an opportunity to experience the challenges of building and managing a lunar outpost.

The project begins with a Moon campaign called Artemis Base Alpha. Students explore a 3D lunar environment, monitor the crew and manage essential resources such as oxygen, water, food and electrical power. They must make decisions about energy use, life-support systems, radiation protection and resource conservation. A Mars campaign is planned as a future unlockable mission.

The platform is designed for students aged 7–16. It uses different learning levels so younger students can explore with simple explanations while older students can engage with more detailed scientific concepts and engineering decisions.

Our main features include a Three.js 3D environment, interactive outpost structures, a resource simulation, science experiments, mission progression and Dr. Astra, an AI astronaut mentor that can explain concepts and guide students.

We developed the application using React, TypeScript, Vite and Three.js, with a Node.js and Express backend. Google Gemini is used for AI-powered guidance, with local educational guidance available when the AI service is unavailable.

We wanted to make space science more than something students simply read about. By allowing them to explore, experiment and make mission decisions, NEOREX ASTRA aims to make learning more practical, engaging and inspiring.
